description: This file defines the interface `StatisticsShardConfig` which specifies configuration methods for statistics shard regions, including retrieving the region name, role, and supervisor actor path. It also includes an enum `ConfigValues` that provides known configuration path expressions and default values.

classes.name: StatisticsShardConfig
classes.description: An interface for configuration related to statistics of shard regions, providing methods to access region name, role, and supervisor root path.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the cluster role where the shard is started.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the actor path of the actor who supervises the shard.
